answers.answer_text: For running shoes for heavy runners in the United States, my top pick is the HOKA Bondi 8, which offers maximum cushioning and a stable base for heavier runners. Another good option is the Brooks Glycerin GTS 21. New Balance is also popular with local runners. I would avoid the Nike Vaporfly 3 because it is unstable at slower paces.
